0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Taina is looking at you as if you had two heads.

24.original: Deliver the bundle of arrows to the villagers.

48.original: Oh, pardon my rudeness. I suppose I was staring too intently. I never thought I would live to see one of the allies of Ronka.

49.original: Doubtless many others in the wood are as curious as I. I had the mind to deliver these arrows to my sisters, but perhaps you should do it in my stead. They would be overjoyed to meet someone so distinguished.

50.original: Please, deliver the arrows to my companions. They would be glad to meet an ally of Ronka.

51.original: Y-You! An ally of Ronka, here!? To what do I owe the honor of this meeting?

52.original: Oh? Arrows? Not what I expected, but...you have my thanks.

53.original: How odd. Until quite recently we only used these arrows to keep others away. Yet here I am, receiving them as a kindness from an outsider.

54.original: Greetings. What business do you have with me?

55.original: What fortunate timing. I am soon to depart on my hunt.

56.original: The wood and the Viis must live together in harmony. To us, the hunt is not leisure─every part of our prey is treated with the utmost respect─from the meat to the bones to the fur.

57.original: One of Ronka's allies, here? Is something amiss?

58.original: Taina sent you on an errand, did she? She is bold if nothing else...

59.original: Nevertheless, your efforts are much appreciated. I always have need of arrows during my patrols. If ever you see me again, do not hesitate to call out. My jaculus does not bite.

60.original: By the gods, an ally of Ronka! Are you certain you meant to speak with me? If so, then...why?

61.original: Arrows, from one such as you? You have a brave soul and a kind heart. Receiving this gift...I am overwhelmed! Pray look the other way!

62.original: Returned at last. One of my companions has already commented on your generous deed. She scolded me, as is her nature.

63.original: However, under her wrath was joy, plain as day. Allow me to thank you again for giving my companions an experience they will not soon forget.
